transcript.note: Round 1. Only one segment was off: 7(2,1)->2(7,0), dx=5 dy=-1. Applied criterion 1 (take H/V when reachable within +/-1-3 cells) together with criterion 4 (do not disturb what is already aligned). Vertex 7 is a hub locked both ways -- row 1 by the H segments 6-7 and 16-7, column 2 by the V segment 8-7 -- so it is the wrong end to move. Vertex 2 is a degree-1 terminus: it carries no other segment, so no aligned chain depends on it and hard rule 4 (edge winding order) does not apply to it. Moving it one row down to (7,1) closes the segment into H rather than settling for 45 degrees, and (7,1) is unoccupied so no collision. Expected 20/21 -> 21/21.
